item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tactical MOLLE Rifle Scabbard ensures effortless transportation of long rifles. This padded rifle case provides additional protection for your firearm, including the scope. Featuring a removable snap carry handle and detachable adjustable shoulder strap, it offers convenient carrying options. With 6 rows of MOLLE webbing and 2 D-rings, it enables mounting of tactical accessories. The quick-release web strap provides easy access to your rifle.
description: Rothco’s Tactical MOLLE Rifle Scabbard ensures effortless transportation of long rifles. This padded rifle case provides additional protection for your firearm, including the scope. Featuring a removable snap carry handle and detachable adjustable shoulder strap, it offers convenient carrying options. With 6 rows of MOLLE webbing and 2 D-rings, it enables mounting of tactical accessories. The quick-release web strap provides easy access to your rifle. Adjustable to fit various barrel lengths, the scabbard features an extended zipper and 2 snap closures. Ideal for storage and transportation, it has an opening measuring 10.5 inches and an overall length of 29.5 inches, along with a grommet drain hole for added convenience.
